full_judgment: The provisions of the statute are wide enough to attract a case of the nature as disclosed from the record. It is for the authority concerned to decide whether a particular Government servant is not required in the interest of the Government of the People's Republic of Bangladesh. The Government has been given the power to Jake action under this statute against any Government servant notwithstanding anything to the contrary contained in any law for the time being in force or in the times and conditions of service of such person. At the hearing of the appeal the learned Counsel appearing for the respondents submitted that since the respondents have been reinstated in compliance with the judgment of the High Court Division and one of them has since been promoted, reversal of the judgment might deprive the respondents of the benefits already enjoyed by them He further submitted that in view of the fact that the Government did not ask for any order staying operation of the judgment of the High Court Division, rather implemented the order of the Court, the appeal is liable to be dismissed on this ground. In consideration of the submissions of the learned Assistant Attorney General, the Government was allowed time to get necessary instruction as to whether the appeal would be pressed in view of the implementation of the judgment. Upon instruction the learned Assistant Attorney General submitted that his instruction is to press the appeal on its merit
